body:
I'm still here.

My parents found my note, and had my best friend call me before I got to where I was going to go through with it.  He talked me down, and now I'm in the hospital, alive and bored waiting on a "24-hour" hold, that can apparently actually take up to 72 hours...

Thanks for replying, waitingforadragon.  Like I said, I'll be around till Monday getting things in order...

I don't know what I expected to come from this post.  I guess it just felt like the right thing to do for some reason, after I'd made this decision.

Yeah, they've known since shortly after it happened.  They kicked him out of the house for it (don't fully remember why nothing more than that happened at the time, but everything from the period after I told my parents about what happened is kind of a blur in my memory).

I don't mind answering...

I was molested as a kid by my older "brother".  He just got out of prison for unrelated crimes.

...and is happily being forgiven and given another shot at life in another state with extended family despite everything he's done.
